categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land ownership determinations for specific parcels of land, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and title classifications. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" including land registrations and title determinations, which aligns perfectly with Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
